author: piztanza
description: Implement the 3D hero fitment scene (F-002): near-1:1 port of .ba/discovery/design-reference/fitment-3d.js into src/components/three/FitmentWheel.tsx as a client-only React component (three from npm), wired into the Hero scene container with lazy loading, lang/static props, fitment-first-loop callback revealing the floating hero cards, and WebGL-unavailable fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Scene graph and timeline match the design reference: wireframe car with feature lines, rear wheel, hub/studs, ground shadows; ~7s mount/dismount loop; 4 bolts streak in and seat with spin; flash ring after seating; entrance ease then idle sway
Projected spec labels (PCD 4×100 / center bore ⌀ 54.1mm / Genuine, with ID translations) appear after the first loop and track their 3D anchor points
A fitment-first-loop callback fires once and reveals the floating hero cards (part card, fit pill, video card)
lang prop switches label text live; static prop (and prefers-reduced-motion) renders the seated wheel with labels immediately visible
three.js is code-split (next/dynamic ssr:false) and initialized only near the viewport; the hero's static gradient shows until ready and remains the fallback when WebGL is unavailable
Renderer disposes cleanly on unmount (no leaked RAF/ResizeObserver); devicePixelRatio capped at 2
Existing suite stays green; new unit tests cover the label set per language and the timeline phase math (wheel z / bolt z at key timestamps)
